name: plessas-marketplace
description: Cross-platform Claude Code plugins for productivity at NBG: decks, mail, meetings, chat, excel, docs.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: Branded presentation system with storyline, storyboard, graphics, QA agents. Bundles icon, infographic, device-mockup creative tools.

plugins.name: mail
plugins.description: Outlook mail with bundled outlook-cli MCP wrapper. Read, draft, triage, style-match, briefings, self-learning.

plugins.name: meetings
plugins.description: Calendar-aware meeting briefings with attendee dossiers, post-meeting decision capture.

plugins.name: chat
plugins.description: Microsoft Teams interactive commands with bundled teams-bridge MCP. Inbox, reply, summarize, channel digest.

plugins.name: excel
plugins.description: Excel analysis: summary, pivot, variance, deck handoff. Wraps document-skills:xlsx.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Word document creation: reports, formal letters, internal memos. Wraps document-skills:docx.
